provenance.ownerPolicy: Blizzard-authored evidence is preferred when it establishes the fact; a dated reputable report may establish a specific region's maintenance window when Blizzard does not publish it. Third-party timing is never labelled Blizzard-authored (owner decision 2026-10-28).
provenance.blizzardAuthoredSearch: No Blizzard-authored, region- and time-specific retail maintenance statement was found for these weeks (Blizzard forums search API, US/EU/CS, 2026-10-28). The Blizzard hotfix log's 2026-09-21 section tags two changes '[With weekly restarts]' but states no region or time, so it does not establish a window and is not recorded as restart evidence.
provenance.coverage: US only. No dated report of an EU maintenance window was found for 2026-09-23 or 2026-09-30, so EU has no restart evidence and resolves nothing.
provenance.excerptNormalization: Excerpts are verbatim except typographic apostrophes and en dashes, rendered as ASCII; HTML-entity apostrophes decoded.
